regions.region: top-left continuation of 3l and 3m/4m scope paragraph
regions.finding: The 3l continuation is characterization only. Two independent 3m/4m runs were recorded with their charges, isolated mixture masses, yields, and NMR product ratios.

regions.region: middle Radical Inhibitor, Radical Initiator, and Crossover experiment paragraphs
regions.finding: Existing Scheme 2a-c records were extended with concrete charges, ordered operations, isolated masses/yields, selectivity methods, recovered 1a, crossover byproduct 5a, and recovered 5b/2a.
The detailed first labeling run was merged into the existing Scheme 2d record and the second run was created separately. The source-label inconsistency 2d versus 2a-d2 was preserved.

unresolved: Product-specific masses and absolute configurations for the 3/4 mixtures are unreported.
The labeled-allene paragraph calls the reagent 2d, whereas its preparation names it 2a-d2; no silent relabeling was made.

regions.finding: Only isotopologue characterization continues here; it supports the run-2 record and is not a separate synthesis.

Four control conditions were kept distinct. Runs 2 and 3 refine existing page-5 summaries; runs 1 and 4 are new records. The 0.2-equivalent summary versus 0.25-equivalent charge-derived pyridine conflict is explicit.

regions.region: product-interconversion Experiments 1a, 1b, and in situ NMR Experiment 2
regions.finding: The EtOH preparation of the 59:41 mixture, the charged-mixture probe ending at 78:22, and the 25.5 h/24-spectrum NMR time course are three distinct records.
Both negative controls were recorded without invented products. The page-3/page-14 starting-material conflict is retained. The SI notice is source context because no SI file is associated.

unresolved: Qualitative non-observation of 2a, 4a, or 5a was not converted into a quantitative zero.
The SI is advertised but not supplied or associated; no SI-only detail was inferred.
